## Indonesia: From Ancient Land to Economic Powerhouse


Indonesia is a wonderful country with a[fascinating history](https://www.trtworld.com/magazine/how-islam-came-to-dominate-indonesia-39182) . Almost two thousand years ago, both Hindu and Buddhist peoples established kingdoms, lasting until the 15th century. With the arrival of Gujarati and Persian merchants in the 13th century, Islam spread throughout the land.


The European period began in 1512 when the Portuguese landed in search of spices. This European influence and colonization lasted several centuries, culminating in independence in 1945, following World War II. Indonesia has enjoyed its independence to the present day.


Indonesia prides itself on having one of the[largest economies in the world](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/indonesia/overview#1) . It has the 15th largest in terms of nominal GDP and the 10thth largest in terms of GDP based on purchasing power parity.


Indonesia’s major cities are Jakarta (the capital), Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, and Bekasi. Its official language is Indonesian.


The[Indonesian diaspora](https://www.diasporaindonesia.org/) can be found all over the world. As of this writing, about 8 million Indonesians are living overseas. While about half a million live in the United States, the vast majority live in the Netherlands, Singapore, and Malaysia.

The information required depends on your chosen delivery method. You may need your recipient’s full name, contact information, and bank or account details. Remitly may also request additional information or documentation to verify your identity or process certain transfers.

Yes, sending limits may apply. Your limit can depend on your account verification status, sending country, transfer details, and applicable regulatory requirements.
